nodes.label: Maskable App Icon 512px
nodes.rationale: The same 512x512 mark rendered noticeably smaller within the canvas, with the beige field bleeding to all four edges. This is the purpose="maskable" manifest entry: Android and other launchers crop app icons to an arbitrary platform shape (circle, squircle, teardrop), and only a variant with deliberate margin survives that crop intact.

nodes.label: Maskable Safe-Zone Padding
nodes.rationale: The mark is inset so it stays inside the central 80 percent safe circle of the icon canvas, leaving the outer band as sacrificial bleed. Compared against icon-512, the artwork is scaled down roughly 15-20 percent while the background extends fully to the edges. Without this inset the outermost sage ring, which is the mark's silhouette, would be shaved by any circular launcher mask and the logo would lose its defining outline.

nodes.label: PWA Installability Icon Set
nodes.rationale: The 192 + 512 + maskable-512 trio is the conventional minimum an installable PWA manifest must declare to satisfy install criteria across browsers and launchers. Manna is deliberately a PWA rather than a native app, so these four files are the entire app-identity surface: there is no store listing or native bundle to carry branding, and the home-screen icon is the only place the product is seen before it is opened.
